name: Kagura Reimeiki ~Ryouka no Shou~
source:
Ryouka travels to find Tome-sama who disappeared with Mikoto. While investigating, Ryouka enters a bamboo grove where suddenly she is enveloped in a light and disappears while pronouncing Mikoto's name.

After that, Ryouka loses her memory and faints. Waking up with no memory, she arrives at a shrine where she is cared for and looked after. One day the shrine receives a request to investigate the ancient shrine of the Dragon God where suspicious disappearances have begun to occur.

Ryouka upon learning of this accepts the request and goes to investigate the ancient shrine. https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_22/index.html
translation:
凉香前往寻找与美琴一起失踪的留大人。在调查过程中，凉香进入了一片竹林，突然间她被光芒笼罩并在念出美琴的名字时消失了。

之后，燎香失去记忆并昏倒了。醒来时失去了记忆，她来到了一座神社，在那里她受到照顾和照顾。有一天，神社收到一项调查龙神的古老神社的请求，那里已经开始发生可疑的失踪事件。

燎香得知此事后接受了请求，前往古老神社进行调查。https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_22/index.html
